prompt: Conservative photographic restoration of this exact scanned 1991 personal garden snapshot for reproduction at small size in a printed book. This is a historical documentary photograph, NOT a new garden visualisation. Keep every actual feature, position, shape, crop bed, path, fence, shed, hill and planting intact; do not add, invent, replace, move or beautify any objects or foliage. Preserve original camera perspective and original colour photograph character. Gently correct faded colour and exposure, modestly open blocked green shadows while retaining highlight detail, lightly reduce scanning grain and JPEG noise and improve edge clarity without artificial textures, oversharpening or HDR. Do not hallucinate individual plant details; uncertain soft detail must stay soft. Retain a credible early-1990s amateur photographic appearance. Crop only a modest amount from the top edge (roughly 8%, to reduce the distant houses) and right edge (roughly 8%, to reduce the dominating shed wall); retain the central path, the original foreground lawn, actual vegetable beds, fence and enough hills to show the original setting. No other compositional changes. Output one restored landscape photograph without text, border or watermark.
caption: The author’s first food garden, 1991.
review: Original and restored compared: overall garden layout, path, foreground lawn, shed, fence and background slopes recognisable; tighter top/right framing, clearer tones.
